# Images selected from the coco128 raw pool for manual bounding-box annotation.
#
# Selection rule: keep every coco128 image that (a) exists as a .jpg in the archive
# and (b) contains at least one object of the target classes (person, car, dog,
# bicycle) according to the original COCO reference labels shipped with coco128.
# The reference labels were used only to choose WHICH images to annotate. They are
# NOT the annotations of this project.
#
# Derived with the coco128 reference labels (class ids: 0=person, 1=bicycle,
# 2=car, 16=dog). Deterministic and re-derivable; see README.md.
#
# Note: coco128 contains two label files without images (000000000656,
# 000000000659) and two images without labels (000000000250, 000000000508).
# Condition (a) removes the label-only entries.
